source: Verified PR146 working tree; source unchanged after final verify and before sequential final benchmarks.
caveats: elapsedMs is measured batch work, excluding scheduler waits, outer bucket hashing/collection packaging and final exports.
Inclusive sampled categories overlap; estimated subtotals must not be summed as an exclusive CPU breakdown.
Original DEV45 baseline briefly overlapped exploratory work; final runs and repeated baseline A/B10 were sequential without other project workloads.
Single runs in mode order share JIT/GC process state; no formal repeated statistical trial.
No frozen DEV90, final capture90, video encoding or full interactive90 elapsed-time result.
Event histories remain complete; heap/RSS are sampled indicators, not exact allocations or a memory cap.
